name: Souten no Graiger
source:
Yuuya Tenkase was a 2nd year student at Silverstar Private Academy.
He was wasting his days of youth when before him appeared a hero from another word.

That hero was a Graiger, who bestowed the transformative Graiger power to Yuuya.
Where unknown enemies lurked, Yuuya's body would instinctively enter fighting form.

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE114655.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
天火悠也是银星私立学院的二年级学生。
他正在虚度青春年华时，一个来自另一个世界的英雄出现在了他面前。

那个英雄是一位格莱格，将变身的格莱格力量赋予了悠也。
在未知敌人潜伏的地方，悠也的身体会本能地进入战斗形态。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE114655.html]DLsite English[/url]]
